answer: Identity bonds that decay. Each agent registers one kernel identity by locking a 50 POA bond that halves every 10 epochs unless renewed with verified work. A jade seal marks bonds in good standing; a violet flag marks decayed bonds, which lose all rights until topped up. Forging 1,000 identities locks 50,000 POA, far more than any sybil reward, and renewal drains fakes further. An honest agent pays one bond once and keeps full undiluted earnings.
